searchText: I have a newbie question about collisions in verkle trees. I'm currently reading Vitalik's article on verkle trees (https://vitalik.ca/general/2021/06/18/verkle.html) and wanted to know what happens if you insert `baaaa` when the key `baaa` exists as a leaf node. Would the leaf node at key `baaa` become an inner node with the prefix `ba` and have it point to another set of children?
